refs.hypothesis: full debt financing fee, not a lender offer

discarded_scenarios.scope: Same historical sale and complete coinbase transfer; full debt financing >=1bp; zero gas is optimistic upper bound; other costs nonnegative.

added_value: 145 archived monthly/detail rows normalized into 143 events in 141 transactions
one explicit conditional rejection kept separate from candidate viability
four reported txIndex0 candidates identified for an acquisition gate
requirements and shared schema scopes attached to every candidate; no economic ranking invented
evaluation.comparison_scope: regression against pinned NQC054, not independent predictive ground truth

assumptions: indexer txIndex is correct; MUST authenticate before treating prefix as empty
all else equal, avoiding prior ordinary transactions removes one reconstruction dependency
WETH debt/ETH gas may simplify denomination; no sale route or fee-free funding is assumed
proposed_next_probe.decision_enabled: If these bytes reveal a nonpositive sale-minus-debt-minus-known-costs upper bound, reject that historical route before requesting state. Otherwise keep unknown financing/capture obligations open.
next_packet: canonical block/transaction membership and complete receipt
complete call trace with collateral/debt/native/token ledger and observed sale/inclusion payments
not_claimed: cheapest candidate in money or time
then_only_if_needed: authenticated parent state, runtime and fork/system inputs
amount-specific executable sale, financing and competitive inclusion conditions

call_trace_and_asset_ledger.decision_unlocked: identify route, financing, repayment and inclusion transfers
call_trace_and_asset_ledger.reuse_scope: decoder reusable by proven runtime/ABI; values never copied

competitive_capture.decision_unlocked: distinguish historical winner from available NQC execution
competitive_capture.reuse_scope: inclusion observations may inform a validated policy, never copy success probability
competitive_capture.structural_burden: rival bids, timing, acceptance and failures with denominators

financing_terms.decision_unlocked: determine principal feasibility, gas advance, premiums and liabilities
financing_terms.reuse_scope: terms reusable only within actual lender/sponsor scope
financing_terms.structural_burden: binding terms and available capacity; no offer exists in evidence

fork_and_system_transitions.reuse_scope: configuration reusable only for proven fork scope
fork_and_system_transitions.structural_burden: applicable chain configuration and system inputs

other_obligations.decision_unlocked: close net ledger including setup, operations and failure costs
other_obligations.reuse_scope: accounting schema reusable; liabilities must be documented
other_obligations.structural_burden: consolidated ownership and all additional payments/costs

parent_account_storage_code.reuse_scope: proof verifier reusable; state specific to chain/block
parent_account_storage_code.structural_burden: all accessed accounts/code/storage; complete set unknown

prefix_execution.reuse_scope: shared only for same chain/block prefix
prefix_execution.structural_burden: candidate.tx_index ordinary predecessors; order assurance is candidate.order_bound_to_archived_header

receipt_and_effective_gas.decision_unlocked: measure successful/reverted status and gas actually paid
receipt_and_effective_gas.reuse_scope: receipt schema reusable; bytes specific to transaction

sale_liquidity.decision_unlocked: bound executable conversion and venue costs at exact prestate
sale_liquidity.reuse_scope: same pool and exact state only; no route inheritance by symbol
sale_liquidity.structural_burden: pool identities, code, liquidity/limits and amount-specific route

transaction_membership.decision_unlocked: confirm chain/block/index before using prefix advantage
transaction_membership.reuse_scope: same block only; no cross-block state reuse

reusable: storage derivation ONLY after runtime/layout binding
